findings.finding: General audit UI accepts STAFF_AUDIT_ONLY and does not include wallet audit table
Some wallet audit writers omit createdAt and targetId, so sparse actor/target indexes cannot provide complete results
Legacy topup approval audit has metadata approvedById but no normalized actor snapshot or before/after
Audit UI does not render financial references and has no date/source/action/operation filtering controls
Company accounting ledger and operational reconciliation exist but do not replace action audit; reconciliation is non-atomic and explicitly reports incompleteness

confirmedControls: Existing staff audit reader requires audit.read and global scope
Reader rejects malformed limits, action and foreign pagination cursors
Nested secrets and signed links are redacted
Historical actor identities are not fabricated
Gateway history has partition-bound paging and separate review queue
implementationRequirements: Read-only finance audit endpoint with explicit permissions and scope, fixed server-owned source allowlist
Bounded date-partition queries and per-source continuation tokens; expose incomplete source failures
Normalize timestamps, references, actor evidence and before/after without inventing historical data
Preserve distinction between payment state and posted financial ledger
UI source/date/action/reference filters and operation detail references; safe text rendering
Verify deployed reader permissions before publishing; no financial mutations for acceptance
